hypothesis: A prefix code over learned FORM first terminals needs only the shortest unique whole-event prefix per rule, allowing the remaining first-terminal suffix, later FORM terminals, and coupled ECHO spans to exceed the 100000-byte correct-parent ceiling.
kill_condition: Retire if shortest unique whole-event prefixes leave J0 below 100000 bytes, any split is nonpositive, or any required control margin is below 20000 bytes.
promotion_condition: Correct-parent free J0 >=100000 bytes; all thirds positive; J0 exceeds F0, E0, C0, S0 by >=20000 bytes; unique triggers span at least three pages; exact WRT/raw alignment.
title: FRACTAL-3 shortest-unique event trigger ceiling
